title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Genesis 28: Jacob sent to Paddan Aram, his dream of the stairway and his vow at Bethel.

questions.text: What did Isaac command Jacob when he blessed him?
questions.explanation: Isaac blessed Jacob and commanded him, "You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan."

answers.text: Not to return to his father's house
Not to take a wife of the daughters of Canaan
Not to speak with his brother Esau
Not to sell the land God gave Abraham

questions.text: Where did Isaac send Jacob to find a wife?
questions.explanation: Isaac said, "Go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother's father," and take a wife from the daughters of Laban.

questions.text: Whom did Esau take as an additional wife in Genesis 28?
questions.explanation: Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, the sister of Nebaioth, in addition to the wives he had.

questions.text: What did Jacob put under his head when he lay down to sleep?
questions.explanation: He took one of the stones of the place, put it under his head, and lay down to sleep.

answers.text: One of the stones of the place
The skin of a young goat

questions.text: What did Jacob see on the stairway in his dream?
questions.explanation: He saw a stairway reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

answers.text: The angels of God going up and down
A flock of white doves flying
A pillar of fire and cloud

questions.text: To what did Yahweh compare Jacob's offspring in the dream?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth," spreading to the west, east, north and south.

questions.text: What did Jacob say when he awoke from his sleep?
questions.explanation: Jacob awakened and said, "Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn't know it."

answers.text: "I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."
"Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn't know it."
"For now Yahweh has made room for us."
"I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses."

questions.text: What did Jacob pour on top of the stone he set up as a pillar?
questions.explanation: He set up the stone as a pillar and poured oil on its top.

questions.text: What was the name of the city at the first, before Jacob called the place Bethel?
questions.explanation: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

questions.text: What did Jacob vow to give to God of all that God would give him?
questions.explanation: Jacob vowed, "Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you."
